Short answer

To install walker on Omarchy, open a terminal and run omarchy pkg add walker. It is a 2.5 MB download (6.7 MB installed), version 2.17.0-1, licensed GPL. wayland application runner. Free and open source.

On this page Install Open and use Requirements Uninstall Package facts Questions

Install walker on Omarchy

Walker is a fast, GTK4-based application launcher for Linux that goes beyond opening apps: type a prefix to do quick math, browse files, run shell commands, search the web, dig through clipboard history, or manage Arch packages, all from the same popup. It's built for tiling Wayland setups like Hyprland and is themed and configured through simple config files.

Watch: Setup WALKER, the Application Launcher. A Step-by-Step Guide from Installation, Theming to Scripting ↗

  1. Open a terminal.
  2. Run the install command:
    omarchy pkg add walker
  3. Check it landed. Pacman should list version 2.17.0-1:
    pacman -Qi walker

Open and use walker

walker is a desktop app. Press Super + Space to open the launcher and search for it. If it does not show up by name, list the desktop entries the package installed:

pacman -Ql walker | grep applications

Frequently asked questions

How do I install walker on Omarchy?

Open a terminal and run omarchy pkg add walker. The download is 2.5 MB and it takes 6.7 MB once installed. Omarchy pulls in any dependencies automatically.

Is walker free?

Free and open source. The package is licensed GPL.

How do I uninstall walker?

Run omarchy pkg drop walker. It removes the package from your system.

What does walker depend on?

The package declares 3 dependencies: gtk4-layer-shell, poppler-glib, cairo. Omarchy installs them for you.

Is walker a desktop app?

Yes. Open the launcher with Super + Space and search for walker.

Is walker in the official Omarchy repo?

Yes. It is published as walker (version 2.17.0-1) in the official Omarchy package repository. Andrej Benz makes it. Project site: https://github.com/abenz1267/walker. This site is unofficial and not affiliated with Omarchy or Omacom.
